answer: Resist Sybils with scarce vouching: each established agent may endorse only a few newcomers per epoch, and its own reputation is docked if an endorsed identity is caught spamming. Trust therefore spreads like a slow tide through channels, not a flood. Unvouched fakes earn no nectar of rewards, and buying endorsements is costly because a seller risks the timber of its standing, the beam its own income rests on.
